system.description:
You begin to recite a song of your choice that radiates illusory chakra that seeps into the psyche of creatures in range. Select the song you wish you recite when this jutsu is cast, each coming with its own set of effects for this jutsu’s duration as they must make an Intelligence saving throw at the beginning of each turn they begin within this jutsu’s radius. You can switch the tune at the beginning of each of your turns by spending a Bonus Action.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature suffers the songs effects.

Critical Failure: Affected creature suffers the songs effects plus the critical bonus.

Ancient Song. Hostile creatures who fail suffers a break of madness, attacking the closest creature to them on their turn until with lowest ranked jutsu. If they critically fail, they instead target themselves automatically scoring a hit.

Painful Song. Hostile creatures who fail experience extreme pain, losing the ability to cast jutsu with the Mobility (M) component. If they critically fail, they also fall Prone.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you use the Reversal Song. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can use the War Song.

Reversal Song. Hostile creatures who gain a bonus of any type from a jutsu, become unable to benefit from those bonuses. If they critically fail, those bonuses become penalties.

War Song. Hostile creatures suffer a -2 penalty to AC and Saving throws. If they critically fail, the penalty extends to all rolls that include dice as well.
